title: Chapter 704
text:
Putting away the mission reward notification, Han Xiao looked at the Random Reward chances he had accumulated. Including the [Bloodline] reward, he had a total of six chances.

"Six chances should be quite high. Since I have enough, let's give it a try." Han Xiao pondered for a while and decided to calculate the Random Reward.

Luck affected the drop rate of all kinds of good items, but the Mission Completion Card was a reward with a lower value. Han Xiao did not want to wait until he returned to the headquarters to touch Fu Ding before drawing the Random Reward.

Drawing … Drawing complete.

The Reward Type you received this time is [Item].

Please choose one from the following three rewards:

1. Double EXP Card (x2)

2. Blank Character Summon Card (x1)

3. Large EXP Crystal (x3)

Nothing came out the first time … Han Xiao was used to it and did not change his expression. He looked at it and chose the blank Character Summon Card. He would use it when he played with Ames another day.

Drawing … Drawing complete.

The Reward Type you received this time is [Item].

Please choose one from the following three rewards:

1. Energy Enhancement Halo (Fashion)

2. Random Dungeon Crystal (x1)

3. Esper Ability Awakening Fluid (Normal)

Han Xiao clicked his tongue. He had gotten an item reward twice in a row, but he did not get a Mission Completion Card. This was not good.

"The things I got this time are ordinary …" Han Xiao touched his chin with a helpless expression. Sure enough, touching Fu Ding and not touching Fu Ding had a different effect. The Lucky Halo was really strong, and he really wanted it.

Seeing that there was nothing good, Han Xiao chose the 'Energy Enhancement Special Effect Halo', a cheap halo type item. Its effect was to strengthen the light effect caused by the release of energy, making the light cannon appear thicker and bigger. It looked scary, but it did not have any practical use. All it had was to make it look cool.

Drawing … Drawing complete.

The type of reward you received this time is: [Talent]

Please choose one from the following three rewards:

1. Golden Ratio Body: + 3% STR, + 3% DEX, + 3% END, + 75 CHA

2. [Electric Eyes]: + 25 CHA, + 5 LUK

3. [Sadist]: + 120 MYS, 50 CHA

"What the hell is this …" Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

This was the good thing about having an unlucky face. He could always see strange things.

The second and third items were of no use to him. Han Xiao chose [Golden Ratio Body]. It was better than nothing. He sighed helplessly and began the fourth random reward.

Drawing … Drawing complete.

Please choose one of the following three rewards:

Mission Completion Card (x1)

2. Small Experience Crystal (x13)

3. Race Sublimation Option Reorganization Card Fragments (x2)

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. After spending four Random Rewards, he finally got a Mission Completion Card. That's it!

After choosing the Mission Completion Card, Han Xiao patiently used the remaining two Random Rewards. He got 2,000,000 EXP and a skill [Skull Crusher], which increased Critical Strike Rate by 40% when attacking the enemy's head. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

One Mission Completion Card after six tries. That's fine. At least it's solved my urgent need.

Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. As long as he got one Mission Completion Card, he would be able to complete the current Promotion Mission. After completing the Promotion Mission, he would have used up all the EXP. He was not in a hurry. He still had seven years to slowly collect more Mission Completion Cards.

You have used [Mission Completion Card].

[Self-challenge] Calculating … Calculation complete!

Level 200 Promotion Mission completed! Promotion successful! END bonus increased! 1 END = 145 HP = 155 Stamina

Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat. It was as if hot lava was pumped out of his body, filling his entire body in an instant. He took a deep breath and felt as if his body was melting, and his cells were undergoing a subtle refinement.

The pain lasted for a while before slowly fading away. Han Xiao panted heavily, sweating profusely. However, he looked very energetic as if he had just gone through a workout. He was full of energy, and his whole body was steaming with heat.

His EXP was finally depleted!

The EXP that he had accumulated was just a number, and it only had value when it was converted into combat power. The EXP that he had accumulated in Version 2.0 was almost completely depleted. After digesting all of it, Han Xiao felt the power surging in his body. This was his current peak state.

"I've finally spent all my EXP …" Han Xiao looked at the notification and realized that his Grade Bonus had also changed.

Once he reached the A rank standard of 10000 Energy Rank, he would receive an A rank bonus. After that, the bonus would increase with every 10,000 Ona.

The original effect was + 10 END, + 8 All Resistances, + 10% Highest Attribute, + 5% Other Attributes, + 30 Free Attribute Points, and + 5 Potential Points.

After the Grade Bonus was upgraded, it became + 15 END, + 12 All Resistances, + 15% Highest Attribute Points, + 8% Other Attributes, + 80 Free Attribute Points, and + 10 Potential Points.

More than half of the Free Attribute Points were invested in Intelligence, and Han Xiao took out 40 points and invested them in END. Currently, the reward for END was very high, and he had accumulated a large amount of Intelligence by investing all his points into Intelligence in the early stages. With the bonuses from his various talents, his END was already very high.

Furthermore, after the battle with EsGod, Han Xiao was quite wary of the attack power of a Beyond Grade A Super, so it was not a loss to invest some points into END.

He then browsed through his attribute interface.

Total Level: 207

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Void Distorter (Human Form)

Attributes: 504 STR, 946 DEX, 1,040 END, 2,859 INT, 432 MYS, 214 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 24

Health: 251780

Stamina: 209320

Energy: 28410 [Lv.12]

Lv.12 Energy Bonus: + 169 STR, + 239 DEX, + 269 END, + 336 INT, + 206 MYS, + 32520 Stamina Limit, + 352% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 24668

Grade: A +

Grade A Bonus: + 15 END, + 12 All Resistances, + 15% Highest Attribute, + 8% Other Attributes, + 80 Free Attribute Points, + 10 Potential Points

As a Mechanic, you're top-notch. As a tank, you're top-notch. Are you really not going to consider abandoning machinery for martial arts?

Tsk, machinery is the way of the king. Learning martial arts will not save the Chinese.

Han Xiao snorted.

In order to complete his Class Advancement, he had spent a total of three years. However, from the success of his Class Advancement to his current Promotion, it had been extremely smooth.

This Promotion was not a Race Evolution, so the change was not huge. However, his health had increased by a quarter compared to before the Promotion. The higher his level, the greater the difference in health.

Han Xiao did not dare imagine how tanky the Tyrant was. Not only was his defense terrifying, but he also probably had a few million health points.

Level 207. I'm even closer to Beyond Grade A. I've spent all the experience I've accumulated. With the experience level of Version 2.0, I might be able to level up four or five times in seven years. If I want to level up quickly, I'll have to wait for the players of Version 3.0 to return.

Han Xiao thought to himself.

…

After the [Bloodline] mission ended, Han Xiao returned to the headquarters to rest for a few days. Taking advantage of the fact that his holiday was not over yet, he flipped through the employment list of the army's Mercenary Department and looked for suitable missions.

The news of Black Star going out for missions quickly spread throughout the Colton Star Cluster and shocked many organizations. With Han Xiao's current status, why would he need to personally take on missions?

Furthermore, aren't you in a war? Why would you have the time to personally take on missions?

Is the secret war so stressful for you?

All the employers in the Colton Star Cluster were excited. With Black Star's strength, what missions would he not be able to complete? All of a sudden, the business of the Black Star Corps' Mercenary Department increased by three times, all because of Han Xiao.

The employers who successfully hired Han Xiao were flattered. Even though they were employers, they treated Han Xiao as if he was their boss, not daring to neglect this person who had the potential to become Beyond Grade A.

Han Xiao's current strength could only be described with one word — reckless!

Be it exterminating the rebels, clearing the beasts, or hunting down the galactic pirates, he would directly descend and crush the enemy. The enemy would not even be able to put up a decent resistance. Han Xiao spent more time on the road than fighting, which made people tremble in fear.

Because Han Xiao was acting alone, he thought that Klent would use the same trick and send people to assassinate him. However, after doing seven or eight missions in a row, nothing happened. Not even a hair of the assassins could be seen.

The incident with DarkStar made Klent suffer a huge loss. Now, they were like birds that were startled by the mere twang of a bow. Seeing Han Xiao wandering outside alone, a special think tank team immediately started making guesses.

With Black Star's status, there was no need for him to personally take on missions.

Therefore, it was obvious …

He's trying to lure us to assassinate him!

He's definitely trying to replicate what happened to the Dark-star leader and find a chance to push the blame to us. This person is evil!

Therefore, the Klents sneered as they watched Han Xiao wandering outside. Humph, his intentions are too obvious. We've seen through him! We definitely won't fall for it!

Furthermore, Klent had just suffered a political blow, so they wanted to keep a low profile for a while. Klent could not think of a way to threaten Han Xiao, so they did not intend to assassinate Han Xiao for the time being. This was also one of the reasons.

While Han Xiao was doing missions and accumulating Random Rewards, the various departments of the Black Star Corps were also developing steadily. They had applied for many technicians from Godora to come to the Black Star Corps to train special talents.

The first investment for Vilna was used up in three months. Reynold followed Han Xiao's request and took out one hundred and fifty million Enas for a second investment.

…

At the port of Floating Dragon Island, a thousand battleships were docked there. They were arranged neatly according to the different battleship models, with two huge flagships as the core of the fleet.

The galactic pirates' spaceships were squeezed to the corner of the dock. They trembled but did not dare to object. This was because the exterior armor of these thousand battleships had a common pattern — a light green Void Dragon head. Below the dragon head was a throne, and a ring surrounded this symbol.

This was the symbol of Floating Dragon's second Field Team!

Vilna and a few assistants accompanied Aesop and Jenny at the dock to inspect this team.

"We now have a thousand battleships produced by a Star System Civilization and three hundred thousand Black Star Troopers. Among them, there are 450 Grade B Supers, 240,000 Grade C Supers, and the rest are Grade D and below. They are mainly in management, logistics, transportation, and so on."

Vilna introduced the current size of Floating Dragon's second Field Team to the two of them.

"It's only been half a year, and you've already achieved such results. Well done," Aesop praised.

"It's mainly because of Black Star's help. It's difficult for me to even earn money by myself," Vilna said.

"How much did he spend?" Jenny asked with a frown.

"Seventy million Enas. A few days ago, he invested another one hundred and fifty million …" Vilna swallowed. Even though she was a Calamity Grade Super, she could not help but be stunned by Han Xiao's wealth.

"He's really willing to spend money …"

Jenny's brows relaxed. She snorted softly and touched her receding hairline helplessly.

"The maintenance cost of these troops is about eight and a half million Enas a month. Black Star is paying for it now. This maintenance cost …" Vilna asked carefully.

"It's a little expensive," Jenny said subconsciously. Suddenly, she paused.

She suddenly remembered that she had almost never given Han Xiao any funding or maintenance fees. Although the Black Star Corps was a Field Team of Floating Dragon, they had always been responsible for their own profits and losses. They even had to give her a portion of their profits every month.

Because the Black Star Corps had almost never asked for funding from Floating Dragon, she rarely thought about it. Only now did she realize that the Black Star Corps was actually very worry-free. They were so passionate about expanding their business because they wanted to earn maintenance fees … Jenny shook her head and felt that she was really not a good manager.

"Black Star helped you build the troops at all costs," Aesop said. "It seems like he has made up his mind. Vilna, you have to think of a way to create income for this army. In the future, the maintenance cost of this army will be borne by us. We don't need too many Field Teams, or the cost will be too high. You can't just accept Black Star's funding. You don't have his ability to earn money, so you have to learn to control the scale. "

"O-Okay …" Vilna hurriedly nodded.

Jenny, who had been silent for a while, sighed. She could not help but say something from the bottom of her heart.

"Black Star is really a rare talent."

Aesop nodded, indicating that he agreed. He paused for a while before helplessly adding.

"It's a pity that he grew too quickly. A person with such talent will not serve others forever …"

…
